def render_list(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', token: Dict[str, Any], state:
    'BlockState') ->str:
    attrs = token.get("attrs", {})
    if attrs.get("ordered"):
        children = _render_ordered_list(renderer, token, state)
    else:
        children = _render_unordered_list(renderer, token, state)
    
    text = "".join(children)
    
    parent = token.get("parent")
    if parent:
        # nested list
        prefix = " " * len(cast(str, parent["leading"]))
        lines = text.splitlines()
        new_lines = []
        for line in lines:
            if line:
                new_lines.append(prefix + line)
            else:
                new_lines.append("")
        text = "\n".join(new_lines) + "\n"
        return "\n" + strip_end(text) + "\n"
    
    return strip_end(text) + "\n"
